jobs.stylePrompt: Render a hand-drawn documentary editorial illustration. When people appear, use natural adult proportions, small anatomically plausible eyes, an understated mouth, and an individual readable expression rather than anime or manga facial construction. Draw with a dry steel nib: fine slightly broken contours, a few uneven short marks, and selective near-black solid shapes at overlaps. Make most surfaces unshaded ivory paper; use a restrained rust-red accent from the supplied subject and very pale cool gray only where needed to separate planes. Describe architecture with economical straight pen lines, omitting repeated distant detail. Keep the focal face and hands legible, with broad open paper areas elsewhere. The drawing should feel observed, serious, and humane. Avoid all-over crosshatching, engraved line density, woodcut carving, screen-tone dots, photographic modeling, and decorative poster silhouettes. Keep the supplied subject, age, expression, clothing, objects, and setting from the independent scene instruction. Do not add narrative props, decorative motifs, text, logos, borders, or watermarks.
jobs.scenePrompt: Create one wide 16:9 landscape image, with no border or typography. A young adult East Asian woman with shoulder-length dark brown hair blowing gently to the left and expressive brown eyes wears a rust-red hooded coat and a black backpack. She holds an unfolded paper map in both hands at chest level, with the entire map visible near the lower edge. Frame her from the waist up in a medium close-up, slightly left of center: her head, torso, and map should fill most of the left half of the image. Her body is turned three-quarters to the right, and she looks up toward the right with a curious, slightly uncertain expression. She stands on a sunlit outdoor commuter-train platform. A long white commuter train with a muted teal stripe remains clearly visible across the right half of the background. The platform canopy and columns recede diagonally from the upper left; a few indistinct commuters stand far behind her. Keep the woman, map, platform, and train all clearly visible.

jobs.stylePrompt: Render a lively hand-drawn everyday editorial illustration for an adult audience. jobs.stylePrompt: Render an original narrative illustration made with broad oil-pastel sticks on lightly textured cream paper. Keep people recognizably adult with natural facial proportions and a restrained expression, without anime construction or photographic skin.
